title: N_lib
description: This project adds library functions to Minecraft to easily create advanced datapacks like mods. We now have discord server: https://discord.gg/xTNrJafs89 <- unlimited link. Datapack is modular u can delete something and it will not stop working
body: New functions that make mathematical operations easier, simplifying the /random command and easy storage management, and a few logical functions, there are very few things you won't be able to create thanks to this, works on many versions from 1.21.10 and up
